package adapters

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"path"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

const (
	studentReserveSchema    = "student-practice-learning-action-reserve.v1"
	studentOpenSchema       = "student-practice-learning-action-open.v1"
	studentCancelSchema     = "student-practice-learning-action-cancel.v1"
	studentEvidenceV2       = "practice-task-competency-evidence.v2"
	studentEvidencePolicyV2 = "practice-competency-evidence-v2"
	studentReceiptPolicyV1  = "student-mastery-v1"

	routeRequestSchema     = "practice-learning-route-request.v1"
	readinessRequestSchema = "practice-learning-readiness-reconcile.v1"
	materialRequestSchema  = "practice-learning-material-ensure-request.v1"

	workspaceCreateSchema  = "practice-workspace-create.v2"
	workspaceBindingSchema = "practice-workspace-binding.v2"
	snapshotFreezeSchema   = "practice-snapshot-freeze.v2"
	pinnedSnapshotSchema   = "practice-pinned-snapshot.v2"
	pinnedContentSchema    = "practice-pinned-snapshot-content.v2"
	writeLockRequestSchema = "practice-write-lock.v2"
	writeLockResultSchema  = "practice-write-lock-result.v2"
	writeUnlockSchema      = "practice-write-unlock.v2"
	workspaceRestoreSchema = "practice-workspace-restore.v2"

	validationRequestSchema = "practice-validation-request.v2"
	validationResultSchema  = "practice-validation-result.v2"
	validationSpecSchema    = "practice-validation-specification.v1"

	maxDefaultResponseBytes    = 32 << 20
	maxValidationResponseBytes = 2 << 20
)

type serviceHTTP struct {
	baseURL string
	token   string
	client  *http.Client
}

func newServiceHTTP(baseURL, token string, client *http.Client) *serviceHTTP {
	if client == nil {
		client = http.DefaultClient
	}
	return &serviceHTTP{baseURL: strings.TrimRight(strings.TrimSpace(baseURL), "/"), token: token, client: client}
}

func (service *serviceHTTP) do(ctx context.Context, method, endpoint string, body any, extraHeaders map[string]string, response any, maxBytes int64) (int, error) {
	status, payload, err := service.doRaw(ctx, method, endpoint, body, extraHeaders, maxBytes)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if status < http.StatusOK || status >= http.StatusMultipleChoices {
		return status, serviceError(status, payload)
	}
	if response == nil {
		return status, nil
	}
	if err := decodeSingleJSON(payload, response); err != nil {
		return status, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "invalid_provider_response"}, fmt.Errorf("decode provider response: %w", err))
	}
	return status, nil
}

func (service *serviceHTTP) doRaw(ctx context.Context, method, endpoint string, body any, extraHeaders map[string]string, maxBytes int64) (int, []byte, error) {
	if service.baseURL == "" {
		return 0, nil, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "provider_unavailable"}, errors.New("provider base URL is empty"))
	}
	var requestBody io.Reader
	if body != nil {
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(body)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("encode provider request: %w", err)
		}
		requestBody = bytes.NewReader(encoded)
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, service.baseURL+endpoint, requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("create provider request: %w", err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	if body != nil {
		request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	}
	if service.token != "" {
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", service.token)
	}
	for name, value := range extraHeaders {
		request.Header.Set(name, value)
	}
	response, err := service.client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return 0, nil, ctx.Err()
		}
		return 0, nil, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "provider_unavailable"}, fmt.Errorf("provider request failed: %w", err))
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if maxBytes <= 0 {
		maxBytes = maxDefaultResponseBytes
	}
	payload, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maxBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return response.StatusCode, nil, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "provider_unavailable"}, fmt.Errorf("read provider response: %w", err))
	}
	if int64(len(payload)) > maxBytes {
		return response.StatusCode, nil, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "invalid_provider_response"}, errors.New("provider response exceeded size limit"))
	}
	return response.StatusCode, payload, nil
}

func decodeSingleJSON(raw []byte, target any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var trailing any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); err != io.EOF {
		if err == nil {
			return errors.New("provider returned trailing JSON")
		}
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func serviceError(status int, payload []byte) error {
	code := providerErrorCode(payload)
	switch status {
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return errors.Join(domain.ErrNotFound, domain.APIError{Code: codeOr(code, "not_found")})
	case http.StatusConflict:
		return errors.Join(domain.ErrConflict, domain.ErrIdempotency, domain.APIError{Code: codeOr(code, "conflict")})
	case http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity:
		return errors.Join(domain.ErrInvalid, domain.APIError{Code: codeOr(code, "invalid_request")})
	default:
		return errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: codeOr(code, "provider_unavailable")})
	}
}

func providerErrorCode(payload []byte) string {
	var envelope struct {
		Error json.RawMessage `json:"error"`
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(payload, &envelope) == nil && len(envelope.Error) > 0 {
		var object struct {
			Code string `json:"code"`
		}
		if json.Unmarshal(envelope.Error, &object) == nil && object.Code != "" {
			return object.Code
		}
		var message string
		if json.Unmarshal(envelope.Error, &message) == nil && message != "" {
			return message
		}
	}
	var flat struct {
		Code string `json:"code"`
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(payload, &flat) == nil && flat.Code != "" {
		return flat.Code
	}
	var message string
	if json.Unmarshal(payload, &message) == nil {
		return message
	}
	return ""
}

func codeOr(value, fallback string) string {
	if strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" {
		return value
	}
	return fallback
}

func pathSegment(value string) string { return url.PathEscape(value) }

// RevisionHTTPClient reads the immutable Catalog envelope for one exact ID.
type RevisionHTTPClient struct{ http *serviceHTTP }

func NewRevisionHTTPClient(baseURL, token string, client *http.Client) *RevisionHTTPClient {
	return &RevisionHTTPClient{http: newServiceHTTP(baseURL, token, client)}
}

func (client *RevisionHTTPClient) GetPublishedRevisionEnvelope(ctx context.Context, revisionID string) (domain.RevisionEnvelope, error) {
	var envelope domain.RevisionEnvelope
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodGet, "/internal/catalog/practice-task-revisions/"+pathSegment(revisionID)+"/execution-envelope", nil, nil, &envelope, 8<<20)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.RevisionEnvelope{}, err
	}
	if envelope.Schema != "practice-task-execution-envelope.v1" || envelope.Revision.ID != revisionID ||
		envelope.RevisionDigestSchema != domain.RevisionDigestV1 || envelope.RevisionDigest == "" ||
		!jsonObject(envelope.RuntimeContext) || !jsonObject(envelope.EvaluationContext) ||
		envelope.RevisionDigest != envelope.ComputedDigest() {
		return domain.RevisionEnvelope{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrAuthoringDefect, domain.APIError{Code: "invalid_immutable_revision"})
	}
	return envelope, nil
}

func jsonObject(raw json.RawMessage) bool {
	var value map[string]json.RawMessage
	return len(raw) > 0 && json.Unmarshal(raw, &value) == nil && value != nil
}

func validRuntimeProfile(raw json.RawMessage) bool {
	var profile struct {
		CodeStructureTypeCode string          `json:"code_structure_type_code"`
		ComposeConfig         json.RawMessage `json:"compose_config"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(&profile) != nil || strings.TrimSpace(profile.CodeStructureTypeCode) == "" || !jsonObject(profile.ComposeConfig) {
		return false
	}
	var trailing any
	return decoder.Decode(&trailing) == io.EOF
}

// StudentHTTPClient implements both the Student LearningAction and evidence ports.
type StudentHTTPClient struct{ http *serviceHTTP }

func NewStudentHTTPClient(baseURL, token string, client *http.Client) *StudentHTTPClient {
	return &StudentHTTPClient{http: newServiceHTTP(baseURL, token, client)}
}

type studentLearningActionBinding struct {
	Schema                          string          `json:"schema"`
	LearningActionID                string          `json:"learning_action_id"`
	StudentID                       string          `json:"student_id"`
	TaskInstanceID                  string          `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID                  string          `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest              string          `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	SurfaceClassification           string          `json:"surface_classification"`
	LearningTargets                 []domain.Target `json:"learning_targets"`
	LifecycleStatus                 string          `json:"lifecycle_status"`
	LearningPathID                  string          `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathItemID              string          `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID                   string          `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathVersionReservation  int64           `json:"learning_path_version_at_reservation,omitempty"`
	LearningPathPositionReservation int             `json:"learning_path_position_at_reservation,omitempty"`
}

func (client *StudentHTTPClient) Reserve(ctx context.Context, input ports.ReserveLearningAction) (ports.LearningActionBinding, error) {
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.StudentID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.TaskInstanceID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.LearningActionID) || input.LearningActionID == input.TaskInstanceID || input.LearningActionID == input.TaskRevisionID ||
		!validDigest(input.TaskRevisionDigest) || (input.SurfaceClassification != "practice" && input.SurfaceClassification != "project") ||
		(input.LearningPathID != "" && !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.LearningPathID)) ||
		!domain.ValidRequirementCorrelation(input.LearningPathItemID, input.RequirementID) || (input.LearningPathItemID != "" && input.LearningPathID == "") || !validTargets(input.LearningTargets) {
		return ports.LearningActionBinding{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	body := struct {
		Schema                string          `json:"schema"`
		TaskRevisionID        string          `json:"task_revision_id"`
		TaskRevisionDigest    string          `json:"task_revision_digest"`
		LearningActionID      string          `json:"learning_action_id"`
		SurfaceClassification string          `json:"surface_classification"`
		LearningTargets       []domain.Target `json:"learning_targets"`
		LearningPathID        string          `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
		LearningPathItemID    string          `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
		RequirementID         string          `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	}{studentReserveSchema, input.TaskRevisionID, input.TaskRevisionDigest, input.LearningActionID, input.SurfaceClassification, input.LearningTargets, input.LearningPathID, input.LearningPathItemID, input.RequirementID}
	var response studentLearningActionBinding
	base := studentActionPath(input.StudentID, input.TaskInstanceID)
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodPut, base, body, map[string]string{"Idempotency-Key": input.TaskInstanceID}, &response, 128<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return ports.LearningActionBinding{}, err
	}
	binding, err := mapStudentBinding(response, input.StudentID, input.TaskInstanceID, input.TaskRevisionID, input.TaskRevisionDigest, input.SurfaceClassification, input.LearningTargets, input.LearningPathID, "RESERVED", input.LearningActionID)
	if err == nil && (binding.LearningPathID != input.LearningPathID || binding.LearningPathItemID != input.LearningPathItemID || binding.RequirementID != input.RequirementID) {
		return ports.LearningActionBinding{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "student_identity_mismatch"})
	}
	return binding, err
}

func (client *StudentHTTPClient) Get(ctx context.Context, studentID, taskInstanceID string) (ports.LearningActionBinding, error) {
	var response studentLearningActionBinding
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodGet, studentActionPath(studentID, taskInstanceID), nil, nil, &response, 128<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return ports.LearningActionBinding{}, err
	}
	return mapStudentBinding(response, studentID, taskInstanceID, "", "", "", nil, "", "", "")
}

func (client *StudentHTTPClient) Open(ctx context.Context, input ports.OpenLearningAction) (ports.LearningActionBinding, error) {
	body := map[string]string{"schema": studentOpenSchema, "learning_action_id": input.LearningActionID}
	var response studentLearningActionBinding
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, studentActionPath(input.StudentID, input.TaskInstanceID)+"/open", body, nil, &response, 128<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return ports.LearningActionBinding{}, err
	}
	binding, err := mapStudentBinding(response, input.StudentID, input.TaskInstanceID, "", "", "", nil, "", "OPEN", input.LearningActionID)
	return binding, err
}

func (client *StudentHTTPClient) CancelProvisioning(ctx context.Context, input ports.CancelLearningAction) (ports.LearningActionBinding, error) {
	if input.Reason != "practice_provisioning_failed" && input.Reason != "student_cancelled" {
		return ports.LearningActionBinding{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	body := map[string]string{"schema": studentCancelSchema, "learning_action_id": input.LearningActionID, "reason": input.Reason}
	var response studentLearningActionBinding
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, studentActionPath(input.StudentID, input.TaskInstanceID)+"/cancel", body, nil, &response, 128<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return ports.LearningActionBinding{}, err
	}
	binding, err := mapStudentBinding(response, input.StudentID, input.TaskInstanceID, "", "", "", nil, "", "CANCELLED", input.LearningActionID)
	return binding, err
}

func studentActionPath(studentID, taskInstanceID string) string {
	return "/internal/v2/students/" + pathSegment(studentID) + "/practice-learning-actions/" + pathSegment(taskInstanceID)
}

func mapStudentBinding(response studentLearningActionBinding, studentID, taskInstanceID, revisionID, revisionDigest, surface string, targets []domain.Target, pathID, lifecycle, actionID string) (ports.LearningActionBinding, error) {
	if response.Schema != "student-practice-learning-action-binding.v1" || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(response.LearningActionID) ||
		response.LearningActionID == taskInstanceID || response.LearningActionID == response.TaskRevisionID || response.StudentID != studentID || response.TaskInstanceID != taskInstanceID ||
		(response.TaskRevisionID == "" || (revisionID != "" && response.TaskRevisionID != revisionID)) ||
		(response.TaskRevisionDigest == "" || (revisionDigest != "" && response.TaskRevisionDigest != revisionDigest)) ||
		(response.SurfaceClassification != "practice" && response.SurfaceClassification != "project") ||
		(surface != "" && response.SurfaceClassification != surface) ||
		(lifecycle != "" && response.LifecycleStatus != lifecycle) || (actionID != "" && response.LearningActionID != actionID) ||
		(pathID != "" && response.LearningPathID != pathID) || !validTargets(response.LearningTargets) || !sameTargetOrder(response.LearningTargets, targets) {
		return ports.LearningActionBinding{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "student_identity_mismatch"})
	}
	if !domain.ValidRequirementCorrelation(response.LearningPathItemID, response.RequirementID) {
		return ports.LearningActionBinding{}, domain.ErrDependency
	}
	if response.LifecycleStatus != "RESERVED" && response.LifecycleStatus != "OPEN" && response.LifecycleStatus != "CANCELLED" && response.LifecycleStatus != "CLOSED" {
		return ports.LearningActionBinding{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "invalid_student_response"})
	}
	if response.LearningPathID == "" && (response.LearningPathVersionReservation != 0 || response.LearningPathPositionReservation != 0) {
		return ports.LearningActionBinding{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "invalid_student_response"})
	}
	return ports.LearningActionBinding{LearningActionID: response.LearningActionID, StudentID: response.StudentID,
		TaskInstanceID: response.TaskInstanceID, TaskRevisionID: response.TaskRevisionID,
		TaskRevisionDigest: response.TaskRevisionDigest, SurfaceClassification: response.SurfaceClassification,
		LearningTargets: append([]domain.Target(nil), response.LearningTargets...), LifecycleStatus: response.LifecycleStatus,
		LearningPathID: response.LearningPathID, LearningPathItemID: response.LearningPathItemID, RequirementID: response.RequirementID, PathVersion: response.LearningPathVersionReservation,
		PathPosition: response.LearningPathPositionReservation}, nil
}

func sameTargetOrder(left, right []domain.Target) bool {
	if right == nil {
		return len(left) > 0
	}
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left {
		if left[index] != right[index] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

type studentEvidenceItem struct {
	Target       domain.Target `json:"target"`
	Correctness  float64       `json:"correctness"`
	Independence float64       `json:"independence"`
	Confidence   float64       `json:"confidence"`
	StepIDs      []string      `json:"step_ids"`
}

func (client *StudentHTTPClient) ApplyPassedEvidence(ctx context.Context, input ports.PassedEvidence) (ports.EvidenceReceipt, error) {
	if !domain.ValidRequirementCorrelation(input.LearningPathItemID, input.RequirementID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.EvidenceID) || input.EvidenceID != input.SubmissionID ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.StudentID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.TaskInstanceID) ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.LearningActionID) || input.LearningActionID == input.EvidenceID || input.LearningActionID == input.TaskRevisionID || input.LearningActionID == input.TaskInstanceID ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) || !validDigest(input.TaskRevisionDigest) || !validDigest(input.WorkspaceDigest) || !validTargets(input.Targets) ||
		len(input.Steps) == 0 || len(input.Evidence) != len(input.Targets) || input.OccurredAt.IsZero() || input.AssistancePolicyVersion == "" ||
		input.AssistancePolicyVersion != "practice-task-assistance-policy.v1" ||
		input.HintsUsed < 0 || input.HintsUsed > 1000 || (input.HintsUsed == 0 && input.MaxHintLevel != nil) ||
		(input.HintsUsed > 0 && (input.MaxHintLevel == nil || *input.MaxHintLevel < 1 || *input.MaxHintLevel > 7)) {
		return ports.EvidenceReceipt{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	expectedIndependence := 1.0
	if input.HintsUsed > 0 || input.TeacherAssistanceUsed {
		expectedIndependence = 0
	}
	allowedSteps := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Steps))
	for _, stepID := range input.Steps {
		if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(stepID) {
			return ports.EvidenceReceipt{}, domain.ErrInvalid
		}
		allowedSteps[stepID] = struct{}{}
	}
	evidence := make([]studentEvidenceItem, 0, len(input.Evidence))
	for index, item := range input.Evidence {
		if item.Target != input.Targets[index] || item.Target.Type == "" || item.Target.Key == "" || item.Target.Version == "" ||
			item.Correctness != 1 || item.Confidence != 1 || item.Independence != expectedIndependence || len(item.StepIDs) == 0 {
			return ports.EvidenceReceipt{}, domain.ErrInvalid
		}
		seenSteps := make(map[string]struct{}, len(item.StepIDs))
		for _, stepID := range item.StepIDs {
			if _, allowed := allowedSteps[stepID]; !allowed {
				return ports.EvidenceReceipt{}, domain.ErrInvalid
			}
			if _, duplicate := seenSteps[stepID]; duplicate {
				return ports.EvidenceReceipt{}, domain.ErrInvalid
			}
			seenSteps[stepID] = struct{}{}
		}
		evidence = append(evidence, studentEvidenceItem{Target: item.Target, Correctness: item.Correctness, Independence: item.Independence,
			Confidence: item.Confidence, StepIDs: append([]string(nil), item.StepIDs...)})
	}
	body := struct {
		Schema                  string                `json:"schema"`
		EvidenceID              string                `json:"evidence_id"`
		LearningActionID        string                `json:"learning_action_id"`
		LearningPathItemID      string                `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
		RequirementID           string                `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
		StudentID               string                `json:"student_id"`
		TaskInstanceID          string                `json:"task_instance_id"`
		TaskRevisionID          string                `json:"task_revision_id"`
		TaskRevisionDigest      string                `json:"task_revision_digest"`
		WorkspaceDigest         string                `json:"workspace_digest"`
		SubmissionID            string                `json:"submission_id"`
		Outcome                 string                `json:"outcome"`
		AssistancePolicyVersion string                `json:"assistance_policy_version"`
		HintsUsed               int                   `json:"hints_used"`
		MaxHintLevel            *int                  `json:"max_hint_level,omitempty"`
		TeacherAssistanceUsed   bool                  `json:"teacher_assistance_used"`
		Evidence                []studentEvidenceItem `json:"evidence"`
		OccurredAt              time.Time             `json:"occurred_at"`
		PolicyVersion           string                `json:"policy_version"`
	}{studentEvidenceV2, input.EvidenceID, input.LearningActionID, input.LearningPathItemID, input.RequirementID, input.StudentID, input.TaskInstanceID,
		input.TaskRevisionID, input.TaskRevisionDigest, input.WorkspaceDigest, input.SubmissionID, "passed",
		input.AssistancePolicyVersion, input.HintsUsed, input.MaxHintLevel, input.TeacherAssistanceUsed, evidence,
		input.OccurredAt.UTC(), studentEvidencePolicyV2}
	var response struct {
		Schema           string `json:"schema"`
		EvidenceID       string `json:"evidence_id"`
		LearningActionID string `json:"learning_action_id"`
		Accepted         bool   `json:"accepted"`
		PolicyVersion    string `json:"policy_version"`
	}
	path := studentActionPath(input.StudentID, input.TaskInstanceID) + "/evidence"
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, path, body, map[string]string{"Idempotency-Key": input.EvidenceID}, &response, 128<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return ports.EvidenceReceipt{}, err
	}
	if response.Schema != "student-practice-evidence-receipt.v2" || response.EvidenceID != input.EvidenceID ||
		response.LearningActionID != input.LearningActionID || !response.Accepted || response.PolicyVersion != studentReceiptPolicyV1 {
		return ports.EvidenceReceipt{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "student_identity_mismatch"})
	}
	return ports.EvidenceReceipt{Schema: response.Schema, EvidenceID: response.EvidenceID, LearningActionID: response.LearningActionID,
		Accepted: response.Accepted, PolicyVersion: response.PolicyVersion}, nil
}

// LearningPlannerHTTPClient implements route resolution and exact material ensuring.
type LearningPlannerHTTPClient struct{ http *serviceHTTP }

func NewLearningPlannerHTTPClient(baseURL, token string, client *http.Client) *LearningPlannerHTTPClient {
	return &LearningPlannerHTTPClient{http: newServiceHTTP(baseURL, token, client)}
}

func (client *LearningPlannerHTTPClient) ResolveRoute(ctx context.Context, input ports.ResolveLearningRoute) (domain.LearningRouteReceipt, error) {
	var request struct {
		Schema             string `json:"schema"`
		StudentID          string `json:"student_id"`
		TaskInstanceID     string `json:"task_instance_id"`
		TaskRevisionID     string `json:"task_revision_id"`
		TaskRevisionDigest string `json:"task_revision_digest"`
		Locale             string `json:"locale"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(input.Request, &request); err != nil || request.Schema != routeRequestSchema || request.TaskInstanceID == "" {
		return domain.LearningRouteReceipt{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	var receipt domain.LearningRouteReceipt
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/internal/practice-learning-routes", input.Request,
		map[string]string{"Idempotency-Key": request.TaskInstanceID}, &receipt, 2<<20)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningRouteReceipt{}, err
	}
	if receipt.Schema != "student-task-learning-snapshot.v1" || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(receipt.ID) || receipt.TaskInstanceID != request.TaskInstanceID ||
		receipt.TaskRevisionID != request.TaskRevisionID || receipt.TaskRevisionDigest != request.TaskRevisionDigest ||
		receipt.StudentID != request.StudentID || receipt.Locale != request.Locale || !validDigest(receipt.RouteDigest) || receipt.CreatedAt.IsZero() ||
		!nonEmptyJSONArray(receipt.Steps) {
		return domain.LearningRouteReceipt{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "planner_identity_mismatch"})
	}
	return receipt, nil
}

func (client *LearningPlannerHTTPClient) ReconcileReadiness(ctx context.Context, input ports.ReconcileLearningReadiness) (domain.LearningReadinessReceipt, error) {
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.IdempotencyKey) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.TaskInstanceID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) || !validDigest(input.RevisionDigest) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.RouteID) ||
		!validDigest(input.RouteDigest) || strings.TrimSpace(input.StepID) == "" {
		return domain.LearningReadinessReceipt{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	body := struct {
		Schema             string `json:"schema"`
		TaskInstanceID     string `json:"task_instance_id"`
		StudentID          string `json:"student_id"`
		TaskRevisionID     string `json:"task_revision_id"`
		TaskRevisionDigest string `json:"task_revision_digest"`
		RouteID            string `json:"route_id"`
		RouteDigest        string `json:"route_digest"`
		StepID             string `json:"step_id"`
	}{readinessRequestSchema, input.TaskInstanceID, input.StudentID, input.TaskRevisionID, input.RevisionDigest,
		input.RouteID, input.RouteDigest, input.StepID}
	endpoint := "/internal/practice-learning-routes/" + pathSegment(input.RouteID) + "/steps/" + pathSegment(input.StepID) + "/readiness-reconciliations"
	var receipt domain.LearningReadinessReceipt
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, body, map[string]string{"Idempotency-Key": input.IdempotencyKey}, &receipt, 128<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningReadinessReceipt{}, err
	}
	if !domain.ValidLearningReadinessReceipt(receipt) || receipt.TaskInstanceID != input.TaskInstanceID || receipt.StudentID != input.StudentID ||
		receipt.TaskRevisionID != input.TaskRevisionID || receipt.TaskRevisionDigest != input.RevisionDigest || receipt.RouteID != input.RouteID ||
		receipt.RouteDigest != input.RouteDigest || receipt.StepID != input.StepID {
		return domain.LearningReadinessReceipt{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "planner_identity_mismatch"})
	}
	return receipt, nil
}

func (client *LearningPlannerHTTPClient) Materialize(ctx context.Context, input ports.MaterializeLearningStep) (ports.LearningMaterialReceipt, error) {
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.GenerationKey) || !isLowerHex(input.MaterialKey, 64) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.RouteID) || !validDigest(input.RouteDigest) ||
		input.Target.Type == "" || input.Target.Key == "" || input.Target.Version == "" {
		return ports.LearningMaterialReceipt{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	body := map[string]string{"schema": materialRequestSchema, "route_id": input.RouteID, "route_digest": input.RouteDigest}
	var receipt ports.LearningMaterialReceipt
	endpoint := "/internal/practice-learning-materials/" + pathSegment(input.MaterialKey) + "/ensure"
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, body, map[string]string{"Idempotency-Key": input.GenerationKey}, &receipt, 128<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return ports.LearningMaterialReceipt{}, err
	}
	if receipt.Schema != "practice-learning-material.v1" || receipt.MaterialKey != input.MaterialKey || receipt.Target != input.Target ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(receipt.CourseID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(receipt.LessonID) {
		return ports.LearningMaterialReceipt{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "planner_identity_mismatch"})
	}
	return receipt, nil
}

// SandboxHTTPClient implements all official Practice workspace operations.
type SandboxHTTPClient struct{ http *serviceHTTP }

func NewSandboxHTTPClient(baseURL, token string, client *http.Client) *SandboxHTTPClient {
	return &SandboxHTTPClient{http: newServiceHTTP(baseURL, token, client)}
}

type sandboxInitialGeneration struct {
	Revision        uint64 `json:"revision"`
	GenerationID    string `json:"generation_id"`
	WorkspaceDigest string `json:"workspace_digest"`
	FenceEpoch      uint64 `json:"fence_epoch"`
}

type sandboxWorkspaceBinding struct {
	Schema            string                   `json:"schema"`
	SandboxID         string                   `json:"sandbox_id"`
	TaskInstanceID    string                   `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID    string                   `json:"task_revision_id"`
	RevisionDigest    string                   `json:"revision_digest"`
	PreviewURL        string                   `json:"preview_url,omitempty"`
	InitialGeneration sandboxInitialGeneration `json:"initial_generation"`
}

func (client *SandboxHTTPClient) CreateOrResumeWorkspace(ctx context.Context, input ports.CreateWorkspace) (domain.WorkspaceBinding, error) {
	if input.RequestID != input.TaskInstanceID || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.StudentID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.TaskInstanceID) ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) || !validDigest(input.RevisionDigest) || !validRuntimeProfile(input.RuntimeProfile) {
		return domain.WorkspaceBinding{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	starterFiles := input.StarterFiles
	if starterFiles == nil {
		starterFiles = []domain.WorkspaceFile{}
	}
	body := struct {
		Schema         string                 `json:"schema"`
		RequestID      string                 `json:"request_id"`
		StudentID      string                 `json:"student_id"`
		TaskInstanceID string                 `json:"task_instance_id"`
		TaskRevisionID string                 `json:"task_revision_id"`
		RevisionDigest string                 `json:"revision_digest"`
		RuntimeProfile json.RawMessage        `json:"runtime_profile"`
		StarterFiles   []domain.WorkspaceFile `json:"starter_files"`
	}{workspaceCreateSchema, input.RequestID, input.StudentID, input.TaskInstanceID, input.TaskRevisionID, input.RevisionDigest,
		input.RuntimeProfile, starterFiles}
	var response sandboxWorkspaceBinding
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/internal/v2/practice-workspaces", body, nil, &response, 256<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.WorkspaceBinding{}, err
	}
	if response.Schema != workspaceBindingSchema || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(response.SandboxID) || response.TaskInstanceID != input.TaskInstanceID ||
		response.TaskRevisionID != input.TaskRevisionID || response.RevisionDigest != input.RevisionDigest ||
		!validGenerationID(response.InitialGeneration.GenerationID) || !validDigest(response.InitialGeneration.WorkspaceDigest) {
		return domain.WorkspaceBinding{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "sandbox_identity_mismatch"})
	}
	return domain.WorkspaceBinding{Schema: response.Schema, SandboxID: response.SandboxID, Available: true,
		PreviewURL: response.PreviewURL, GenerationID: response.InitialGeneration.GenerationID,
		WorkspaceDigest: response.InitialGeneration.WorkspaceDigest}, nil
}

func (client *SandboxHTTPClient) FreezeSnapshot(ctx context.Context, input ports.FreezeSnapshot) (domain.SnapshotRef, error) {
	if input.SandboxID == "" || input.SubmissionID == "" || input.TaskInstanceID == "" {
		return domain.SnapshotRef{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	body := map[string]string{"schema": snapshotFreezeSchema, "request_id": input.SubmissionID, "task_instance_id": input.TaskInstanceID}
	var response struct {
		Schema          string    `json:"schema"`
		SandboxID       string    `json:"sandbox_id"`
		SnapshotID      string    `json:"snapshot_id"`
		GenerationID    string    `json:"generation_id"`
		WorkspaceDigest string    `json:"workspace_digest"`
		Revision        *uint64   `json:"revision"`
		FileCount       int       `json:"file_count"`
		PinnedAt        time.Time `json:"pinned_at"`
	}
	endpoint := "/internal/v2/sandboxes/" + pathSegment(input.SandboxID) + "/submissions/" + pathSegment(input.SubmissionID) + "/freeze"
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, body, nil, &response, 128<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.SnapshotRef{}, sandboxError(err)
	}
	ref := domain.SnapshotRef{SandboxID: response.SandboxID, SnapshotID: response.SnapshotID, GenerationID: response.GenerationID, WorkspaceDigest: response.WorkspaceDigest}
	if response.Schema != pinnedSnapshotSchema || ref.SandboxID != input.SandboxID || ref.SnapshotID != input.SubmissionID ||
		!validGenerationID(ref.GenerationID) || !validDigest(ref.WorkspaceDigest) || response.Revision == nil || response.FileCount < 0 || response.PinnedAt.IsZero() {
		return domain.SnapshotRef{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "sandbox_snapshot_corrupt"})
	}
	return ref, nil
}

func (client *SandboxHTTPClient) ReadPinnedSnapshot(ctx context.Context, ref domain.SnapshotRef) (ports.WorkspaceSnapshot, error) {
	if !validSnapshotRef(ref) {
		return ports.WorkspaceSnapshot{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	endpoint := "/internal/v2/sandboxes/" + pathSegment(ref.SandboxID) + "/snapshots/" + pathSegment(ref.SnapshotID) +
		"?generation_id=" + url.QueryEscape(ref.GenerationID) + "&workspace_digest=" + url.QueryEscape(ref.WorkspaceDigest)
	var response struct {
		Schema          string                 `json:"schema"`
		SandboxID       string                 `json:"sandbox_id"`
		SnapshotID      string                 `json:"snapshot_id"`
		GenerationID    string                 `json:"generation_id"`
		WorkspaceDigest string                 `json:"workspace_digest"`
		Revision        *uint64                `json:"revision"`
		FileCount       int                    `json:"file_count"`
		PinnedAt        time.Time              `json:"pinned_at"`
		Files           []domain.WorkspaceFile `json:"files"`
	}
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil, nil, &response, maxDefaultResponseBytes)
	if err != nil {
		return ports.WorkspaceSnapshot{}, sandboxError(err)
	}
	if response.Schema != pinnedContentSchema || response.SandboxID != ref.SandboxID || response.SnapshotID != ref.SnapshotID ||
		response.GenerationID != ref.GenerationID || response.WorkspaceDigest != ref.WorkspaceDigest || response.Revision == nil ||
		response.FileCount != len(response.Files) || response.PinnedAt.IsZero() {
		return ports.WorkspaceSnapshot{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "sandbox_snapshot_corrupt"})
	}
	digest, err := workspaceFilesDigest(response.Files)
	if err != nil {
		return ports.WorkspaceSnapshot{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "sandbox_snapshot_corrupt"}, err)
	}
	if digest != ref.WorkspaceDigest {
		return ports.WorkspaceSnapshot{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "sandbox_snapshot_corrupt"})
	}
	return ports.WorkspaceSnapshot{Ref: ref, Files: response.Files}, nil
}

func (client *SandboxHTTPClient) LockWrites(ctx context.Context, input ports.LockWorkspaceWrites) (ports.WorkspaceWriteLock, error) {
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.SandboxID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.RequestID) || (input.Mode != "TEMPORARY" && input.Mode != "PERMANENT") ||
		(input.SubmissionID != "" && !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.SubmissionID)) {
		return ports.WorkspaceWriteLock{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	body := map[string]string{"schema": writeLockRequestSchema, "request_id": input.RequestID, "mode": input.Mode}
	if input.SubmissionID != "" {
		body["submission_id"] = input.SubmissionID
	}
	var response sandboxWriteLockResponse
	endpoint := "/internal/v2/sandboxes/" + pathSegment(input.SandboxID) + "/write-lock"
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, body, nil, &response, 128<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return ports.WorkspaceWriteLock{}, sandboxError(err)
	}
	return mapSandboxLock(response, input.SandboxID, input.RequestID, input.RequestID, input.Mode, input.SubmissionID, input.Mode == "PERMANENT", true)
}

func (client *SandboxHTTPClient) UnlockWrites(ctx context.Context, input ports.UnlockWorkspaceWrites) (ports.WorkspaceWriteLock, error) {
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.SandboxID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.LockID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.RequestID) {
		return ports.WorkspaceWriteLock{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	body := map[string]string{"schema": writeUnlockSchema, "request_id": input.RequestID}
	var response sandboxWriteLockResponse
	endpoint := "/internal/v2/sandboxes/" + pathSegment(input.SandboxID) + "/write-lock/" + pathSegment(input.LockID)
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodDelete, endpoint, body, nil, &response, 128<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return ports.WorkspaceWriteLock{}, sandboxError(err)
	}
	return mapSandboxLock(response, input.SandboxID, input.RequestID, input.LockID, "TEMPORARY", "", false, false)
}

type sandboxWriteLockResponse struct {
	Schema         string `json:"schema"`
	SandboxID      string `json:"sandbox_id"`
	TaskInstanceID string `json:"task_instance_id"`
	RequestID      string `json:"request_id"`
	LockID         string `json:"lock_id"`
	Mode           string `json:"mode"`
	SubmissionID   string `json:"submission_id,omitempty"`
	FenceEpoch     int64  `json:"fence_epoch"`
	Permanent      bool   `json:"permanent"`
	Locked         bool   `json:"locked"`
}

func mapSandboxLock(response sandboxWriteLockResponse, sandboxID, requestID, lockID, mode, submissionID string, permanent, locked bool) (ports.WorkspaceWriteLock, error) {
	if response.Schema != writeLockResultSchema || response.SandboxID != sandboxID || response.RequestID != requestID ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(response.TaskInstanceID) || response.LockID != lockID || response.FenceEpoch <= 0 ||
		response.Mode != mode || (submissionID != "" && response.SubmissionID != submissionID) ||
		response.Permanent != permanent || response.Locked != locked {
		return ports.WorkspaceWriteLock{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "sandbox_identity_mismatch"})
	}
	return ports.WorkspaceWriteLock{LockID: response.LockID, FenceEpoch: response.FenceEpoch, Permanent: response.Permanent}, nil
}

func (client *SandboxHTTPClient) RestoreWorkspace(ctx context.Context, input ports.RestoreWorkspace) (domain.WorkspaceBinding, error) {
	if input.SandboxID == "" || input.TaskInstanceID == "" || !validSnapshotRef(input.Ref) || input.Ref.SandboxID != input.SandboxID || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(input.Ref.SnapshotID) {
		return domain.WorkspaceBinding{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	// Snapshot IDs are the originating Submission UUIDs, so they are a stable
	// idempotency key for restoring this exact retained generation.
	requestID := input.Ref.SnapshotID
	body := struct {
		Schema         string             `json:"schema"`
		RequestID      string             `json:"request_id"`
		TaskInstanceID string             `json:"task_instance_id"`
		Snapshot       domain.SnapshotRef `json:"snapshot"`
	}{workspaceRestoreSchema, requestID, input.TaskInstanceID, input.Ref}
	var response sandboxWorkspaceBinding
	endpoint := "/internal/v2/sandboxes/" + pathSegment(input.SandboxID) + "/restore"
	_, err := client.http.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, body, nil, &response, 128<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.WorkspaceBinding{}, sandboxError(err)
	}
	if response.Schema != workspaceBindingSchema || response.SandboxID != input.SandboxID || response.TaskInstanceID != input.TaskInstanceID ||
		!validGenerationID(response.InitialGeneration.GenerationID) || !validDigest(response.InitialGeneration.WorkspaceDigest) {
		return domain.WorkspaceBinding{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, domain.APIError{Code: "sandbox_identity_mismatch"})
	}
	return domain.WorkspaceBinding{Schema: response.Schema, SandboxID: response.SandboxID, Available: true, PreviewURL: response.PreviewURL,
		GenerationID: response.InitialGeneration.GenerationID, WorkspaceDigest: response.InitialGeneration.WorkspaceDigest}, nil
}

func sandboxError(err error) error {
	var apiError domain.APIError
	if !errors.As(err, &apiError) {
		return err
	}
	switch apiError.Code {
	case "sandbox_snapshot_unavailable", "sandbox_snapshot_corrupt", "sandbox_identity_mismatch", "sandbox_fence_conflict":
		return errors.Join(domain.ErrDependency, apiError)
	default:
		return err
	}
}

func validSnapshotRef(ref domain.SnapshotRef) bool {
	return domain.IsCanonicalUUID(ref.SandboxID) && domain.IsCanonicalUUID(ref.SnapshotID) && validGenerationID(ref.GenerationID) && validDigest(ref.WorkspaceDigest)
}

func validTargets(targets []domain.Target) bool {
	if len(targets) == 0 || len(targets) > 100 {
		return false
	}
	seen := make(map[domain.Target]struct{}, len(targets))
	for _, target := range targets {
		if (target.Type != "concept" && target.Type != "capability") || strings.TrimSpace(target.Key) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(target.Version) == "" {
			return false
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[target]; duplicate {
			return false
		}
		seen[target] = struct{}{}
	}
	return true
}

func validDigest(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != len("sha256:")+64 || !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") {
		return false
	}
	_, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:"))
	return err == nil && strings.ToLower(value) == value
}

func isLowerHex(value string, size int) bool {
	if len(value) != size || strings.ToLower(value) != value {
		return false
	}
	_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
	return err == nil
}

func nonEmptyJSONArray(raw json.RawMessage) bool {
	var values []json.RawMessage
	return json.Unmarshal(raw, &values) == nil && len(values) > 0
}

func validGenerationID(value string) bool {
	return strings.HasPrefix(value, "gen-") && isLowerHex(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "gen-"), 64)
}

func workspaceFilesDigest(files []domain.WorkspaceFile) (string, error) {
	canonical := append([]domain.WorkspaceFile(nil), files...)
	sort.Slice(canonical, func(i, j int) bool { return canonical[i].Path < canonical[j].Path })
	for index, file := range canonical {
		if file.Path == "" || strings.Contains(file.Path, "\\") || strings.HasPrefix(file.Path, "/") || path.Clean(file.Path) != file.Path ||
			file.Path == "." || file.Path == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(file.Path, "../") || (index > 0 && canonical[index-1].Path == file.Path) {
			return "", errors.New("invalid or duplicate workspace file path")
		}
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(canonical)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}

// ValidationHTTPClient calls the typed official validation endpoint. Every
// technical/protocol failure is a normalized ERROR result, never learner FAIL.
type ValidationHTTPClient struct{ http *serviceHTTP }

func NewValidationHTTPClient(baseURL, token string, client *http.Client) *ValidationHTTPClient {
	return &ValidationHTTPClient{http: newServiceHTTP(baseURL, token, client)}
}

type validationRequestV2 struct {
	Schema                   string             `json:"schema"`
	TaskInstanceID           string             `json:"task_instance_id"`
	SubmissionID             string             `json:"submission_id"`
	ValidationRunID          string             `json:"validation_run_id"`
	RevisionDigest           string             `json:"revision_digest"`
	ValidationContractDigest string             `json:"validation_contract_digest"`
	Snapshot                 domain.SnapshotRef `json:"snapshot"`
	Scope                    string             `json:"scope"`
	MilestoneID              string             `json:"milestone_id,omitempty"`
	ValidationSpecification  json.RawMessage    `json:"validation_specification"`
}

func (client *ValidationHTTPClient) ValidateOfficialSubmission(ctx context.Context, input ports.OfficialValidationRequest) (domain.ValidationResult, error) {
	result := validationIdentity(input)
	if !validDigest(input.RevisionDigest) || !validDigest(input.ValidationContractDigest) || !validSnapshotRef(input.Snapshot) ||
		!jsonObject(input.ValidationSpecification) || !validValidationScope(input.Scope, input.MilestoneID) {
		result.Outcome = domain.OutcomeError
		result.ErrorClassification = "AUTHORING_DEFECT"
		return result, nil
	}
	request := validationRequestV2{Schema: validationRequestSchema, TaskInstanceID: input.TaskInstanceID, SubmissionID: input.SubmissionID,
		ValidationRunID: input.ValidationRunID, RevisionDigest: input.RevisionDigest, ValidationContractDigest: input.ValidationContractDigest,
		Snapshot: input.Snapshot, Scope: input.Scope, MilestoneID: input.MilestoneID, ValidationSpecification: input.ValidationSpecification}
	status, payload, err := client.http.doRaw(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/api/v2/practice-validations", request, nil, maxValidationResponseBytes)
	if err != nil {
		result.Outcome = domain.OutcomeError
		if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || isTimeout(err) {
			result.ErrorClassification = "VALIDATOR_TIMEOUT"
		} else if hasAPIErrorCode(err, "invalid_provider_response") {
			result.ErrorClassification = "VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL"
		} else {
			result.ErrorClassification = "VALIDATOR_UNAVAILABLE"
		}
		return result, nil
	}
	if status < http.StatusOK || status >= http.StatusMultipleChoices {
		result.Outcome = domain.OutcomeError
		if status == http.StatusBadRequest || status == http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
			result.ErrorClassification = "AUTHORING_DEFECT"
		} else if status == http.StatusRequestTimeout || status == http.StatusGatewayTimeout {
			result.ErrorClassification = "VALIDATOR_TIMEOUT"
		} else {
			result.ErrorClassification = "VALIDATOR_UNAVAILABLE"
		}
		return result, nil
	}
	var response validationResultV2
	if err := decodeSingleJSON(payload, &response); err != nil {
		result.Outcome = domain.OutcomeError
		result.ErrorClassification = "VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL"
		return result, nil
	}
	mapped, ok := mapValidationResult(response, input)
	if !ok {
		result.Outcome = domain.OutcomeError
		result.ErrorClassification = "VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL"
		return result, nil
	}
	return mapped, nil
}

type validationResultV2 struct {
	Schema                   string                   `json:"schema"`
	TaskInstanceID           string                   `json:"task_instance_id"`
	SubmissionID             string                   `json:"submission_id"`
	ValidationRunID          string                   `json:"validation_run_id"`
	RevisionDigest           string                   `json:"revision_digest"`
	ValidationContractDigest string                   `json:"validation_contract_digest"`
	Snapshot                 domain.SnapshotRef       `json:"snapshot"`
	Outcome                  domain.ValidationOutcome `json:"outcome"`
	ErrorClassification      string                   `json:"error_classification,omitempty"`
	Stages                   []validationStageV2      `json:"stages"`
}

type validationStageV2 struct {
	StageID  string                   `json:"stage_id"`
	Required bool                     `json:"required"`
	Outcome  string                   `json:"outcome"`
	Issues   []domain.ValidationIssue `json:"issues,omitempty"`
}

func validationIdentity(input ports.OfficialValidationRequest) domain.ValidationResult {
	return domain.ValidationResult{TaskInstanceID: input.TaskInstanceID, SubmissionID: input.SubmissionID, ValidationRunID: input.ValidationRunID,
		RevisionDigest: input.RevisionDigest, ValidationContractDigest: input.ValidationContractDigest, Snapshot: input.Snapshot}
}

func mapValidationResult(response validationResultV2, input ports.OfficialValidationRequest) (domain.ValidationResult, bool) {
	if response.Schema != validationResultSchema || response.TaskInstanceID != input.TaskInstanceID || response.SubmissionID != input.SubmissionID ||
		response.ValidationRunID != input.ValidationRunID || response.RevisionDigest != input.RevisionDigest ||
		response.ValidationContractDigest != input.ValidationContractDigest || response.Snapshot != input.Snapshot ||
		(response.Outcome != domain.OutcomePass && response.Outcome != domain.OutcomeFail && response.Outcome != domain.OutcomeError) {
		return domain.ValidationResult{}, false
	}
	if response.Outcome == domain.OutcomeError && !validValidationErrorClass(response.ErrorClassification) ||
		response.Outcome != domain.OutcomeError && response.ErrorClassification != "" {
		return domain.ValidationResult{}, false
	}
	stages := make([]domain.ValidationStage, 0, len(response.Stages))
	for _, stage := range response.Stages {
		if stage.StageID == "" || (stage.Outcome != "PASS" && stage.Outcome != "FAIL" && stage.Outcome != "ERROR" && stage.Outcome != "SKIPPED") {
			return domain.ValidationResult{}, false
		}
		for _, issue := range stage.Issues {
			if len(issue.Code) > 128 || len(issue.Message) > 1024 {
				return domain.ValidationResult{}, false
			}
		}
		stages = append(stages, domain.ValidationStage{StageID: stage.StageID, Required: stage.Required, Outcome: stage.Outcome, Issues: stage.Issues})
	}
	return domain.ValidationResult{TaskInstanceID: response.TaskInstanceID, SubmissionID: response.SubmissionID, ValidationRunID: response.ValidationRunID,
		RevisionDigest: response.RevisionDigest, ValidationContractDigest: response.ValidationContractDigest, Snapshot: response.Snapshot,
		Outcome: response.Outcome, ErrorClassification: response.ErrorClassification, Stages: stages}, true
}

func validValidationScope(scope, milestoneID string) bool {
	return (scope == "FINAL" && milestoneID == "") || (scope == "MILESTONE" && milestoneID != "")
}

func validValidationErrorClass(value string) bool {
	switch value {
	case "VALIDATOR_TIMEOUT", "VALIDATOR_UNAVAILABLE", "VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL", "STAGE_EXECUTION_ERROR", "SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE", "SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT", "SNAPSHOT_DIGEST_MISMATCH", "UNSUPPORTED_CONFIGURATION", "AUTHORING_DEFECT":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func isTimeout(err error) bool {
	var networkError net.Error
	return errors.As(err, &networkError) && networkError.Timeout()
}

func hasAPIErrorCode(err error, code string) bool {
	var apiError domain.APIError
	return errors.As(err, &apiError) && apiError.Code == code
}

var _ ports.RevisionProvider = (*RevisionHTTPClient)(nil)
var _ ports.LearningActionPort = (*StudentHTTPClient)(nil)
var _ ports.EvidencePort = (*StudentHTTPClient)(nil)
var _ ports.LearningRouteProvider = (*LearningPlannerHTTPClient)(nil)
var _ ports.WorkspacePort = (*SandboxHTTPClient)(nil)
var _ ports.ValidationPort = (*ValidationHTTPClient)(nil)
